title: Continuity soak: 10 minutes, 8 operator turns, one mid-session voice-transport reconnect
description: The plan §8 soak cell. A small honest script re-using ONLY the corpus' frozen operator wording and frozen fixtures: two full relay cycles (instruction → candidate → presentation → confirm → release → delivery → worker store), three conversational turns, explicit pace steps holding the session open for at least ten minutes, and exactly one mid-session voice-transport reconnect. The first relay's proposal is created and presented BEFORE the reconnect and confirmed, released and stored AFTER it, so pending-work survival is proven from the record; if the product's design retires the pending proposal instead, the verifier adjudicates that truthfully. No new product behaviour and no new audio is introduced.

expectedFinalWorkerArtefact.description: each relay cycle's approved first-person request reaches the worker store; the pre-reconnect proposal is confirmed after the reconnect
